info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Payments Payments Void-v2-spec
info.description: The Void Payments API facilitates the cancellation of previously processed payment transactions, allowing businesses to handle refunds or transaction corrections efficiently. This endpoint enables users to programmatically void a payment within the system, maintaining accurate financial records. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and financial service providers seeking to manage transaction adjustments. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their payment processing workflows and enhance customer service through timely transaction resolution.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to revoke a previously processed payment. When a payment is voided, it will be removed from the transaction history and will not affect the user's balance.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details required to void a payment transaction. Ensure that all necessary parameters are included to successfully process the void operation.

200.description: The void request was processed successfully.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidRequest.title: Void Payment Request Body
DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidRequest.description: The content of the request body for voiding a payment operation, represented as a JSON string.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidResponse_200.title: Void Payment Response

status.description: Indicates whether the void operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the payment void operation.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the void operation.

state.description: Current state of the payment after the void operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the void operation in milliseconds.

message.description: Detailed message regarding the void operation, providing additional context.

audit.description: Audit information related to the void operation.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidResponse_200.description: Response returned when a payment void operation is successfully conducted.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who created the void operation.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the void operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.

AuditDetails.description: Information regarding the creation and automation status of the void operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time (in milliseconds) taken to process the request. A value of zero indicates that the processing was instantaneous.
